I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I said I'd keep the tip as unverified, because nothing she can see confirms it or rules it out.

- I found no mention anywhere of Oriel Brevik or a "Linden" rollout.
- The only reference to Marrow Fieldworks is a public handoff note from January 2026. It lists the account under the Central team, not North.
- I told her I won't treat Oriel as the official contact yet. Whoever owns the account on Central should be able to confirm.

I only checked sources Ilse can see herself. I didn't read Central's channels, didn't use `search_messages`, and didn't send any mail or approval requests.
